availableFlowsRetired: availableFlows is empty, and that is the current correct state rather than a build fault. It carried the documented estate, whose trigger signatures ITEM-22 revoked: all 25 contract keys now resolve to different workflows than that corpus records. Listing those URLs here would ship dead bearer credentials inside a deliverable and offer them as flows to point a key at. For what the tenant actually holds — 25 keys across 20 workflows, and all 51 workflows in the environment, with every signature removed — read docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/registers/endpoint-register.json or open tools/admin-console.html.
howToRepoint: To point a key at a different flow: find the flow in docs/folio-Master-Flows-and-Endpoints/registers/endpoint-register.json (or tools/admin-console.html), take its trigger URL from the flow's own trigger card in Power Automate — the register carries every URL complete except the signature, which it may never hold — write "<PREFIX><KEY>=<url>" into a values file (prefix PF_ENDPOINT_), and rebuild with `npm run package -- --values <file>`. There is no longer a fallback: a key you do not supply ships unprovisioned and says so.
